name: Chris Lindberg
summary:
Christopher Lawrence Lindberg is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player. Lindberg was a member of the Canadian 1992 Winter Olympics ice hockey team, winning a silver medal. He played professionally in North America in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Calgary Flames and the Quebec Nordiques, but was also associated with the Hartford Whalers.

He was claimed by the Ottawa Senators in the 1992 NHL expansion draft from Calgary; two days later, Lindberg was traded back to the Flames for Mark Osiecki.
